title: Introduction to Computer Architecture
description: The architecture of computer systems including concepts such as CPU, memory, buses, I/O, cache, instruction sets and interrupt processing. Families of processors, CISC, RISC. Memory organization and management. Computer arithmetic. Assembly language programming and its interface with a high-level language (C). An introduction to basic networking concepts.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 230, CENG 255, ECE 255.
